🎥🍿: Ebenezer 

On a frozen Christmas Eve, the wealthy but cold-hearted Ebenezer Scrooge dismisses kindness as a weakness and sees the holiday as nothing more than a distraction from business. His cynical worldview is shattered when an ominous ghost appears, warning that he has one final chance to escape a horrifying destiny.

Guided through the shadows of his forgotten past, the hardships of the present, and a future consumed by death and regret, Scrooge uncovers the true cost of his greed. Each vision grows darker and more unsettling, forcing him to confront the man he has become. Starring Johnny Depp, Ebenezer reinvents the classic tale with haunting gothic visuals, supernatural suspense, and a powerful story of redemption.
